thread:
Priya: Hey team — quick ask: I have 3 docs PRs that need review/approval this week. Can we do a buddy-review pairing so each PR gets 2 eyes before merge? PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412, https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/413, https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/414. Prefer merge after CI/docs-preview passes. :wave:

Mason: @Priya happy to take one. Which ones are smaller? I have bandwidth Thu/Fri.

Elaine: I can take the migration guide one (413). There's a gap in the rotation Friday morning though — that's when we usually do merge windows. If we pair, suggest: 412 -> Mason + Sam, 413 -> Elaine + Priya, 414 -> Mason + Elaine.

Priya: thanks @Elaine, 413 is the migration guide (bigger). 412 is a snippet fix, 414 is link + example. Can you put suggestions in the PRs? I'll add a `buddy-review` label.

docs-bot: Docs preview for PR 412: https://deploy-preview-412.netlify.app — status: pending checks: docs-preview, lint. PR 413: https://deploy-preview-413.netlify.app — checks: passed. PR 414: https://deploy-preview-414.netlify.app — checks: pending. (automated message)

Sam: @Mason I can pair with you on 412 if you want to split review. Quick question: do we require both approvals or one approval + author signoff? :eyes: 

Mason: Per doc process it's 1 reviewer + owner approval, but buddy-review is optional for knowledge sharing. For release-adjacent merges we prefer 2 approvals. For these, 1 + owner is fine.

Elaine: Also note CI/docs preview flaked for 412 yesterday (timed out on generated-snippets job). If you re-run the preview check, add `--no-cache` to the build command:

```
npm run build -- --no-cache
```

that fixed it for me last week.

Priya: good call. I've re-run the preview on 412, queued now. I'll add a note in PRs about merge timing: aim for Thu 10:00 PT merge window unless blockers.

Mason: :thumbsup: ping me on Thursday morning and I'll merge after QA pass. @docs-bot can you re-run checks for 412 in the morning?

docs-bot: Action queued: re-run checks for PR 412 at 2026-04-02T15:00:00Z.

Sam: I'll do a quick smoke test of the snippets after merge. If anything breaks we can revert quickly.

Priya: Thanks all — assigning reviewers now and adding the buddy-review label. Will update the rotation doc later to avoid weekend gaps. :sparkles:
